prompt: Who was the Prime Minister of Canada the first time that The Toronto Maple Leafs won The Stanley Cup?
answer:
The franchise that became the Toronto Maple Leafs first won the Stanley Cup in **1918**, when it was known as the **Toronto Arenas**. Canada’s Prime Minister at the time was **Sir Robert Borden**.

*(If you mean the first Cup won under the “Toronto Maple Leafs” name, in 1932, the prime minister was R. B. Bennett.)*
